metadata.title: Awesome Claude Skills
metadata.description: A curated index of Claude skills organized by category

skills.name: docx
skills.description: Create, edit, analyze Word docs with tracked changes, comments, formatting.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Extract text, tables, metadata, merge & annotate PDFs.

skills.name: pptx
skills.description: Read, generate, and adjust slides, layouts, templates.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Spreadsheet manipulation: formulas, charts, data transformations.

skills.name: artifacts-builder
skills.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui).

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Creates isolated git worktrees with smart directory selection and safety verification.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Guides completion of development work by presenting clear options and handling chosen workflow.

skills.name: pypict-claude-skill
skills.description: Design comprehensive test cases using PICT (Pairwise Independent Combinatorial Testing) for requirements or code, generating optimized test suites with pairwise coverage.

skills.name: root-cause-tracing
skills.description: Use when errors occur deep in execution and you need to trace back to find the original trigger

skills.name: csv-data-summarizer-claude-skill
skills.description: Automatically analyzes CSVs: columns, distributions, missing data, correlations.

skills.name: article-extractor
skills.description: Extract full article text and metadata from web pages.

skills.name: content-research-writer
skills.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section

skills.name: internal-comms
skills.description: Create internal communications	(status reports, leadership updates, etc)

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Transform rough ideas into fully-formed designs through structured questioning and alternative exploration.

skills.name: tapestry
skills.description: Interlink and summarize related documents into knowledge networks.

skills.name: ship-learn-next
skills.description: Skill to help iterate on what to build or learn next, based on feedback loops.

skills.name: youtube-transcript
skills.description: Fetch transcripts from YouTube videos and prepare summaries.

skills.name: video-downloader
skills.description: Downloads videos from YouTube and other platforms for offline viewing, editing, or archival.

skills.name: image-enhancer
skills.description: Improves the quality of images, especially screenshots.

skills.name: claude-epub-skill
skills.description: Parse and analyze EPUB ebook contents for querying or summarizing.

skills.name: git-pushing
skills.description: Automate git operations and repository interactions.

skills.name: review-implementing
skills.description: Evaluate code implementation plans and align with specs.

skills.name: test-fixing
skills.description: Detect failing tests and propose patches or fixes.

skills.name: meeting-insights-analyzer
skills.description: Transforms your meeting transcripts into actionable insights about your communication patterns

skills.name: ffuf_claude_skill
skills.description: Integrate Claude with FFUF (fuzzing) and analyze results for vulnerabilities.

skills.name: defense-in-depth
skills.description: Implement multi-layered testing and security best practices.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

skills.name: file-organizer
skills.description: Intelligently organizes your files and folders across your computer.

skills.name: invoice-organizer
skills.description: Automatically organizes invoices and receipts for tax preparation

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Template / helper to build new Claude skills.

skills.name: template-skill
skills.description: Minimal skeleton for a new skill project structure.
